risksByCategory.title: Column Data Type Modifications
risksByCategory.description: 17 column data type modifications detected. Potential data truncation or conversion failure if unhandled.
risksByCategory.mitigation: Use explicit SQL USING clauses with type casting functions and verify staging data before applying to production.

risksByCategory.title: Foreign Key Referential Integrity Validation
risksByCategory.description: 7 foreign key constraints need creation or verification. Existing orphan records could cause constraint creation failures.
risksByCategory.mitigation: Execute orphan record detection queries prior to applying ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT FOREIGN KEY.

risksByCategory.title: Index Creation Overhead
risksByCategory.description: Creating 27 indexes concurrently may consume I/O resources during peak traffic.
risksByCategory.mitigation: Execute CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY outside peak business hours to prevent table write blocking.

risksByCategory.title: Access Exclusive Table Locking
risksByCategory.description: ALTER TABLE operations acquire ACCESS EXCLUSIVE locks on 147 tables, temporarily blocking concurrent queries.
risksByCategory.mitigation: Set statement_timeout = "5s" and lock_timeout = "2s" in PostgreSQL session to prevent lock queue blockage.

risksByCategory.title: Application Backward Compatibility
risksByCategory.description: Zero destructive renames. New tables and columns added incrementally.
risksByCategory.mitigation: Deploy database migration prior to backend code release.

beforeMigration.details: Ensure point-in-time snapshot or pg_dump backup is successfully generated and verified.
Confirm the current database schema hash matches the expected target hash in reports.
Ensure no active long-running write transactions exist on target tables.
Configure lock_timeout = "2s" and statement_timeout = "10s" for the migration session.

duringMigration.details: Execute each migration stage within an explicit BEGIN ... COMMIT transaction block.
Track ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock hold times during DDL execution.
Immediately rollback active transaction on any SQL execution error or constraint failure.

afterMigration.details: Verify schema match rate reaches 100% and zero differences remain.
Execute orphan record check across newly introduced foreign keys.
Confirm all created btree indexes are marked as valid and ready for query optimizer.
Compare table row counts before and after migration to guarantee zero inadvertent data loss.

recommendations: 1. Execute full database snapshot backup prior to starting Stage 1.
2. Set lock_timeout = "2s" in migration session to protect production read queries.
3. Run migration stages in sequential order within explicit BEGIN ... COMMIT blocks.
5. Re-run Database Inspector post-migration to verify 100% schema match rate.
